utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning, 8 o'clock sharp. That'll give us time to sort the tools before folks start showing up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You can count on me, Eli. I'll be there early to help you get that sign-in table set up and ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good man, Sam. I'll have the coffee ready by 7:30 so we can start the day right.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I came by the garage Saturday morning like I promised, but the door was locked. Did the repair drive get rescheduled?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I'm so sorry for the confusion, Uli! The repair drive was moved to Sunday at the community center—I should have made sure everyone knew.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ah, thanks for letting me know. I wish someone had told me earlier, but I'll be there Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, tell me straight—is this repair drive going to actually solve something, or is it just making us feel busy while nothing changes?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Well, uh, I think it's a bit of both, Mina. At least if someone fixes my old lamp, that's one less thing gathering dust, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you're saying it's mostly symbolic, then? Because I'd rather know if we're actually getting results or just keeping up appearances.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, just wanted to make sure you heard—the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center. I've got my tools set aside already.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, Sunday at the community center—got it. Wait, didn't we say Saturday on the porch? I hope I'm not bringing my stuff to the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it changed last minute—sorry about the confusion. I'll be there Sunday morning with my socket set and a few extra screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I was talking with Quinn about the repair drive—thinking of bringing in some old tools I've got.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that's great! And hey, did you hear they moved it to Sunday at the community center? Just spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that's good to know—Sunday works better for me anyway. I'll make sure to sort through my stuff by then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Cleo, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? Gus is donating his old tools, and we could really use a hand organizing things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I heard! I've already started sorting through my spare parts pile—found a few things that might come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's great, Cleo! Every bit helps. Could you bring those spare parts to the community center on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We're fixing up fences, porches, and even some leaky faucets—everyone's pitching in!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that sounds great, Quinn! But do we have a list of all the tools and materials we'll need? I'd hate to start and realize we're missing a wrench or something.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Good thinking, Pia! I actually started a list—let me grab it from my pocket. We’ve got hammers, nails, and plenty of paint, but I think you're right about checking for wrenches and screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Vik, just a heads up—the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Sunday? Got it, so it's at the community center on Sunday now. I'll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that's the one. Thanks for helping get the word out—I don't want anyone showing up at my front porch on Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Bo, you've got wrenches? That's perfect! I wish I'd heard about this sooner myself, but I'm glad you can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Nell, just a quick update—I moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on my porch. Hope that still works for you!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Jules! Sunday works for me — I'll make sure to bring those wrenches Bo mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, I noticed you heading over to the repair drive earlier. Did you find the spot okay?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I found it! I'm relieved it's a community repair event, not just a USB drive—I was getting mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, I'm glad you cleared that up! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center at 10 a.m. — don't forget to bring any rusty tools you want fixed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mara, have you heard? The repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead—hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I just heard about the change—Sunday at the community center works even better for me, I'll be there!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh that's great news, Mara! I was worried the change might mess up folks' plans, but it sounds like it's working out perfectly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the tool kits ready for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday? You mean the Hendersons' repair drive, right? I just want to make sure we're all talking about the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, Hendersons' place. Tool kits are set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Awesome, Dane! So Saturday it is—I'll bring my toaster, you bring the drive. Let's fix some things up!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: You bet! I'll have the drive ready—just hope my soldering skills are still sharp enough to keep up with your toaster wizardry.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Haha, your soldering's always been solid, Dane! Can't wait to see that drive in action—and my toaster back in one piece.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Oren, just a heads-up — I heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday? Oh, right, the repair drive. I'm glad I bumped into you — I keep forgetting where I left my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Oren — I've got a spare toolkit in my truck if you need to borrow one for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday, huh? That changes things. I'll need to rearrange my morning walk, but I suppose I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's a bit of a bummer about the date change, but at least the community center has more space—might make getting things done easier.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, there's two different repair drives—are you talking about the community repair event Jules mentioned, or the one for the router?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Ah, the community garden shed and benches! That's the one Jules is talking about too. The router fix is a whole other thing—maybe we should tackle that next!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, the community repair event for the garden. I'll bring my toolbox and some extra screws for the benches.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, found it alright. Opal pointed me the right way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, so it's Sunday at the community center — got it, thanks!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Right, Sunday at the community center. I'll bring some of my own tools too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Rosa! Thanks for the update, I'll make sure to spread the word about the change.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Jules! Let me know if you need any flyers or anything else.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think I'm all set on flyers, but thanks for offering! I already told Leo about the change too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mara, have you heard about the repair drive happening on Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, actually it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center—still on, just a different day!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks Mara! I'll shift my calendar — glad I checked with you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Opal, have you double-checked the list of supplies for the repair drive? I want to be sure we're not forgetting anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got the list right here — tools, oil, and some spare parts. All set for Saturday at 10!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, but did you remember to pack extra fuses and a flashlight? You never know when we might need them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that's brilliant! Every little bit helps—we can always use more tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to hear it! I'll swing by my shed and grab that folding table tonight so it's ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that's perfect! I was hoping we'd have a proper spot to work—brings back good memories from the last repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Well, Gus's tools will be a big help! Do you think he could drop them off Friday evening so I can sort through them over the weekend?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, honey, I just heard the repair drive got moved—it's now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday like we first thought.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that changes things! I'll have to rearrange my sorting plans—could still use Friday evening to get a head start though.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, wait, so it's a community center thing? I thought we were moving files around. I'm still a bit lost.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, yeah, it's a tool repair drive at the community center on Saturday. I think Quinn's been helping organize it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Saturday? I thought I heard it was Sunday now—did it change again?
